# CDA Separation: kickoff (multi-root workspace)

Read cda-separation/AGENTS.md and cda-separation/context/brief.md, and follow AGENTS.md.
The repos are not under repos/. CDWP is at <CDWP path> and CDW is at <CDW path>. Both are read only.
Record both paths in work/state.md and use them wherever AGENTS.md says repos/cdwp or repos/cdw.
Create work/ and deliverables/ inside cda-separation/ only, never inside the CDWP or CDW repos.
Run init, then discover paml. Stop after discover paml with a 10-line summary and the new open questions.
